Ukrainian ex-officer on trial in Germany for Nord Stream sabotage

A trial has opened in Hamburg, Germany, against Serhii Kuznietsov, a former Ukrainian officer accused of leading a group of divers who allegedly placed explosives on the Nord Stream gas pipelines in the Baltic Sea. The sabotage targeted the pipelines connecting Russia to Germany four years ago. Kuznietsov's lawyers are seeking a dismissal of the charges. Some coverage describes the event as a 'war crime'.
